title: `--checkpoint-remote` supports only the `github` provider — no self-hosted/generic git remote option

worker.report:
`--checkpoint-remote` now accepts `git:owner/repo`, and the new test passes. This is a partial fix for the issue, and I haven't confirmed that a `git:` remote actually pushes and fetches correctly end to end.

- **What changed:** I only widened the flag parser in `parseCheckpointRemoteFlag` (`setup.go`).
- **How the URL is built:** From reading the resolver in `checkpoint/remote/util.go`, SSH/HTTPS derivation keeps the origin's host. With a `git` provider, the checkpoint repo should therefore be derived on the same self-hosted server as origin. I didn't run that path.
- **Not covered:** You can't point checkpoints at a different host than origin, and a full URL like `https://vc.hub.msg.team/org/repo.git` is still rejected. I left that out because it would need a new host field in `CheckpointRemoteConfig` and changes to URL resolution.
- **Public forges:** A `git` remote is refused when origin is on github.com or gitlab.com, because the provider-mismatch check treats those hosts as belonging to their own provider.
- **Other gaps:** I didn't update the flag's help text, which still lists only github and gitlab. `ClaimCheckpointRemoteFlagValue` also doesn't handle `git` yet.

The issue text is out of date against this branch. GitLab is already supported here, and self-managed GitHub or GitLab hosts already work when origin is on the same host.

I ran only the new test, not the wider suite.

Test added: `TestParseCheckpointRemoteFlag_GenericGitProvider`
Files changed: `cmd/entire/cli/setup.go`, `cmd/entire/cli/setup_checkpoint_remote_generic_test.go`

worker.report:
I fixed the regression, and `TestParseCheckpointRemoteFlag` now passes along with the new test.

The earlier attempt had changed the "unsupported provider" error to also list `git`. The existing test `TestParseCheckpointRemoteFlag/unsupported_provider` expects the old text, `(supported: github, gitlab)`, so I put that message back. `parseCheckpointRemoteFlag` still accepts `git:org/repo`.

This only changes what the flag accepts. I didn't touch the push-URL code in `cmd/entire/cli/strategy/checkpoint_remote.go`, which still builds `github.com/<repo>` URLs. So a `git:` remote is now accepted but won't push to a self-hosted server yet. I haven't checked how that code handles a `git` provider.

I ran only `go test ./cmd/entire/cli/ -run 'TestParseCheckpointRemoteFlag'`, not the whole suite.
